cvOptimizer.name: CV Optimizer Pro
cvOptimizer.desc: CV optimizers inflate achievements with phrases a recruiter detects in seconds. This one does the opposite: 3 Claude agents — recruiter, career coach and anti-exaggeration auditor — extract the real profile through a conversational interview and generate CVs with verified credibility, semantic job matching and an application Kanban.

jobHunter.name: Job Hunter Platform
jobHunter.desc: 116+ REST endpoints, scraping 7 sources every 6 hours and CVs generated in 4 styles. A Celery + Redis pipeline turns manual job hunting into a React dashboard with AI ranking and real-time metrics.

tcg.name: TCG Collection Manager
tcg.desc: Born from a physical collection impossible to inventory by hand: the camera scans each card from a React Native app, OpenCV and Tesseract analyze its condition, and TCGPlayer scraping keeps prices current on a Streamlit dashboard.

pokemontcgai.name: Pokémon TCG AI Battle Agent
pokemontcgai.desc: Picking the optimal move under hidden information and massive combinatorial interactions is intractable with fixed rules. This multi-agent RL agent (Kaggle 2026 competition) trains policies with Stable-Baselines3 and PettingZoo, validating every improvement over runs of n≥1000 games.

financial.name: Family Finance
financial.desc: 11 Flutter screens to bring order to a family's expenses: financial analysis with GPT-4o-mini, voice expense entry via webhooks (Google Assistant/Siri) and per-role family permissions. Multi-platform with Riverpod and Cloud Functions.

nocheAustral.name: Noche Austral
nocheAustral.desc: Complete astronomy outreach platform as graduation project: a 16,000+ line Flutter app built with Clean Architecture, unit tests and CI/CD, plus a Django web CMS deployed on GCP App Engine with role-based Firebase authentication.
nocheAustral.mobile: Moon phases, ISS tracker, NASA APOD and 3 educational games, with separated presentation, domain and infrastructure layers.
nocheAustral.web: Django CMS with articles, comments and an admin panel, served from GCP App Engine.
